text:
taylor: quick flag after the SDK rollout: a handful of docs still use `max_tokens` and the old `function_call` payload. Dedicated customers are hitting errors.

kim: thanks. list of impacted files?

taylor: snippets/js/generate.md, guides/migrations/v1-to-v2.md (code blocks), integrations/vector-stores/postgres.md (embed dim note).

owen: i'll patch JS + TS snippets. plan: small codemod or sed to rename `max_tokens` -> `max_output_tokens` and change function examples to the `tool_calls` array shape. will add before/after and a short smoke test.

kim: add a migration note that Hosted will keep a short compatibility shim but Dedicated/Private may already enforce the new fields. also add a prominent warning on vector-store pages about dim changes (1536 -> 2048) and reindex steps.

taylor: draft deprecation line for banner: "Legacy `max_tokens` and `function_call` removed 2026-07-01; update by 2026-06-01." i'll confirm with PMs then publish.

docs-bot: PRs opened for snippets and guide. CI lint passed; snippet smoke tests queued.

(THREAD END)
